info.title: Thalamus console jobs source
info.description: The paths a jobs source serves to the Thalamus console. The console forwards /api/jobs/<path> to <source>/v1/console/<path> with the bearer token attached. The rules every answer follows are in docs/console-jobs-source.md: the source composes the words and picks the tones, and the pages print them as text.

get.description: `path` may span segments (a/b.js). The console's forwarder refuses any path containing `..` or `//`, or starting with `/`, with 400 before it reaches a source.

200.description: The file. Every response carries the sandbox policy and the CORS header.

Content-Security-Policy.example: sandbox allow-scripts; default-src 'none'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval' blob:; worker-src blob:; connect-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'

Error.description: Every error, from the source or from the console's proxy.

Tone.description: The colour a word is printed in. It only ever repeats the word beside it. ok: a run that found something (notable). faint: a run that stayed silent. danger: a failure. pending: running, or changed and not yet re-run. muted: a neutral fact with no status, such as when a collector last moved. accent: the console's own emphasis, for a tagged commit or the next run. A new tone is a design decision: it is added here only after the designer assigns it a meaning. A page shown a tone it does not know prints the word muted.

Status.description: A status: the word the source chose, and its tone.

RunStatus.description: A run's status. The word set is closed, and each word has one tone (x-tones). A run made of stages is failed if any stage failed, else running if any stage runs, else the status of its last stage that ran. skipped is faint, like silent: nothing ran.

Label.description: The operator's verdict on a finding.

items.description: A first try. found and ep_lost are null until the engine has scored it.

ChessData.description: The chess-positions app's read grant, field for field. Opponent names, PGN, comments and chat have no field.

found.description: Must equal ep_lost <= 0.05; null until scored.

engine_move.description: The try was exactly the engine move; null until scored.

ChessTry.description: The chess-positions app's write grant, one row per first try. Submit writes the row at once with the verdict fields null, which locks the position; a later write with the same uci and a verdict scores it. A row that has a verdict is never scored again (409).

AppData.description: Per app: only the fields its grant reads.

AppRow.description: Per app: only the fields its grant writes.

BadRequest.description: The request was malformed: a body field, a query value, or a path the console's forwarder refused.

example.error: label: one of useful, not_useful, wrong

Unauthorized.description: The bearer token was missing or wrong. The console attaches it; a page never sees this unless the console's token file is stale.

NotFound.description: No such job, run, commit, change, app or file.

Conflict.description: Well formed, but the state does not allow it: the board changed since it was opened, a position already has its first try, a job declares no command, or the change cannot be reverted cleanly.

example.error: the board changed since you opened it; reload and edit again

ServerError.description: The source failed, for example a git command.

ProxyUnreachable.description: Answered by the console's proxy, never by a source: the source did not answer, redirected (a source must not; the console never follows one), sent a body shorter than its Content-Length or larger than the console's cap, or the console's token file could not be read.
